newsitem.title: FRANCE: Nice reports 16.5pct Nov 96 airfreight increase.
newsitem.headline: Nice reports 16.5pct Nov 96 airfreight increase.

text.p: Nice-Cote d'Azur airport reported a 16.5 percent increase in airfreight traffic for November 1996 over the same month in 1995, with throughput reaching 1,696 tonnes.
Cargo throughput totalled 16,321 tonnes, down six percent on 1995 levels, airport authority figures show.
The Air France group generates the major part of cargo traffic handled at Nice Airport.
Express operators United Parcel Service and DHL Worldwide Express operate scheduled feeder flights to and from Nice as part of their intra-European air cargo networks.
November 1996 postal traffic was up 8.3 percent on the same month the previous year at 8,053 tonnes.
French airline L'Aeropostale carries overnight mail between its Paris-Charles de Gaulle hub and Nice on a regular basis using Boeing 737QC aircraft.
